caption:
Seeking knowledge: a path that Allah makes easy toward Paradise.

The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever takes a path to seek knowledge, Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him. Start this Monday by learning one small thing about your faith.

Jami at-Tirmidhi 2646 · Grade: Sahih

What is one thing you want to learn this week? Share it below.

#seekingknowledge #islamicknowledge #learnislam #sunnah
